reasons.coin-thief+priest: A thief and a priest: taking from the enemy and giving to friends can become one gesture.
reasons.gambler+hourglass: Chance meets a clock: the time rule can make the gamble certain on schedule.
reasons.mirror+trickster: Two rule-thieves: the fusion has to steal rules in a way neither parent does.
reasons.berserker+candle: Both live on missing HP: one refuses to die, the other hits harder the more it bleeds.
reasons.nautilus+thornback: The armour and the spikes: what a hit gives it and what it gives back.
reasons.magnet+prism: Two rule-benders on statuses: one pulls them, one bounces them; Maks's pick of the best three.
reasons.gravecaller+raven: Two death-rules: remembering the fallen and bringing them back.
reasons.chrysalis+seed: Two slow growers: a timed metamorphosis that can pass to an ally.
reasons.hexer+sniper: Both reach the enemy's back line: silence and the shot.
reasons.bodyguard+medic: Protection two ways: take the hit or heal it.
reasons.leech+vulture: Two feeders: one drinks from strikes, the other from deaths.
reasons.hydra+lone-wolf: Many heads against the lone wolf: one wants a crowd, the other wants to stand alone; Maks's pick of the best three.
reasons.conductor+drummer: Two rhythm units: ally actions build a beat, and the beat repeats actions.
reasons.bully+frostling: Freeze sets up the Bully's double hit: a combo inside one unit.
reasons.alchemist+hornet: Brewing and stinging: Poison made and Poison spread in one unit; Maks's pick of the best three.
reasons.fortune-teller+war-horn: Both read the board's numbers: who has more units, how few stand.
reasons.aegis+lantern: Two shields: one cancels the first hit, one works while untouched.
reasons.archmage+battery: The pool's two Charge builders: the fusion must spend Charge differently from both.
reasons.frost-witch+oracle: Two timed debuffers: Freeze on turn 2, Curse from turn 3.
reasons.executioner+gravedigger: Death as fuel: kills and fallen allies both count.

coin-thief+priest.name: Shadow Almoner
coin-thief+priest.why: One battle-start gesture: blesses its neighbours and curses an enemy by the same PWR. Lean A was a long Charge rule.

gambler+hourglass.name: Tempo Trickster
gambler+hourglass.why: A coin flip decides whether the line behind acts again now or echoes a turn later. Both parents in one sentence.

mirror+trickster.name: Glass Mimic
mirror+trickster.why: Learns the front enemy's rule by watching it act and keeps it as a second rule. Rule Pilferer was the Trickster on turn 3.

berserker+candle.name: Last Ember
berserker+candle.why: Under the new stats Martyr Flame fell to 28% and the other two came into band: it refuses to die and burns the front enemy for all it has lost, the Berserker and the Candle in one moment. Wickrager is close to the Berserker alone.

nautilus+thornback.name: Grudge Whorl
nautilus+thornback.why: Every hit it has taken comes back on the next attacker: grows like the shell, bites like the spikes.

magnet+prism.name: Spite Mirror
magnet+prism.why: Pays a status back to whoever gave it to an ally, and grows each time: the Magnet's pull and the Prism's bounce in one short rule. Hexlens only takes it on itself; Reflectorus is a long Charge rule.

gravecaller+raven.name: Omen Scavenger
gravecaller+raven.why: Takes the first fallen ally's rule and blesses itself against death. Corvid Reaper was the Gravecaller a turn late.

chrysalis+seed.name: Sproutshell
chrysalis+seed.why: The only one in band: from turn 2 it heals and blesses the ally behind.

hexer+sniper.name: Frostbolt Hex
hexer+sniper.why: The only one in band (from a top-up run): shoots both ends of the enemy line, and on turn 2 freezes them.

bodyguard+medic.name: Pain Conduit
bodyguard+medic.why: Its own pain heals its neighbours: a third creature in one short line. The leans were Bodyguard or Medic again.

leech+vulture.name: Bloodcrow
leech+vulture.why: The only one in band (from a top-up run): each enemy death heals the ally behind.

hydra+lone-wolf.name: Grief Fang
hydra+lone-wolf.why: The lone wolf's last stand fed by the line's losses: strikes twice, harder for each fallen ally. Last Head is just a Hydra with three heads; Solitary Hydra stacks two conditions.

conductor+drummer.name: Downbeat Marshal
conductor+drummer.why: Every third ally action plays again: the beat and the repeat in one rule.

bully+frostling.name: Chillknuckle
bully+frostling.why: The only one in band: freezes, then curses what is already frozen.

alchemist+hornet.name: Venom Brewer
alchemist+hornet.why: Every poisoned enemy gets Poison equal to the turn number at turn end: it brews what the Hornet spread. Toxin Swarmer is a Charge counter; Plague Vespa waits on a death.

fortune-teller+war-horn.name: Omen Horn
fortune-teller+war-horn.why: Each ally death rallies the line, Shield when outnumbered, otherwise Strength. The other two were long or hidden.

aegis+lantern.name: Vigil Flame
aegis+lantern.why: While untouched, it builds Charge and shields the whole line. Frostwarden was Bodyguard with a Freeze.

archmage+battery.name: Voltmage
archmage+battery.why: The only one in band: the hits its allies took become a storm on every enemy.

frost-witch+oracle.name: Rime Seer
frost-witch+oracle.why: Freezes every enemy on turn 2 and curses them a turn later: both parents' timing in one line.

executioner+gravedigger.name: Grave Headsman
executioner+gravedigger.why: Each kill turns its fallen allies into power. Tollkeeper was close to the Gravedigger.

discover.mirror+raven: two rule-thieves: whose rule does the fusion end up with?
discover.gambler+lone-wolf: double strikes: what happens to the gamble?
discover.medic+nautilus: healing meets the shell: watch a hit on an ally.
discover.bully+hornet: poison and punishment: watch a poisoned enemy.
discover.gravedigger+hydra: falling heads: what does each death feed?
discover.priest+seed: slow growth and Blessing: watch the ally behind over the turns.
discover.aegis+thornback: a wall that bites: watch the first hit each turn.
discover.archmage+oracle: Charge and curses: watch from turn 3.
discover.executioner+vulture: kills feed it: watch a chain of kills.
discover.lantern+seed: a light and a sprout: watch the allies next to it over the turns.
